articles.title: Friday the 13th: Why Does This Day Scare So Many People?
articles.summary: Friday, November 13, 2026 is the year's last Friday the 13th. Theories trace the fear to the number 13 and to Friday itself, yet a 2008 study found fewer accidents that day, and shoppers may even find lucky deals.

articles.title: Ella Langley Shares a Thoughtful New Song for the Next 'Hunger Games' Film
articles.summary: Ella Langley's gentle new song, 'Here Then We're Gone,' leads the 29-track soundtrack for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, out in theaters November 20.

articles.title: Route 66 Turns 100: A Road Trip Through a Century of Pop Culture
articles.summary: Route 66 turns 100 in 2026, and its century of songs, films, and roadside adventures still draws travelers from Chicago to California.
